neighbours.label: Function words/commas right where a clause or comparison is about to open after a predicate of checking, asking, knowing or likelihood ('make sure', 'find out if', 'ask if', 'in order for', 'less likely', 'to know'), also list-commas after a predicted outcome; weak, mixed pole
fire: Before you leave the house, double-check the stove to make sure the burners are all off.
She phoned the clinic on Monday to find out if they had any openings later that week.
Participants who slept under six hours were 20% less likely to finish the puzzle correctly.
The committee moved the meeting to evening in order for the new members to attend.
If a dog eats grapes it may vomit, shake, seem tired, or stop eating altogether.
Buyers will happily pay extra to know that the coffee they drink was grown ethically.
Ask whether the landlord covers repairs before you put your name on anything.
The app has passed 250,000+ downloads since its quiet launch last spring.
quiet: Before you leave the house, turn off the stove burners and unplug the kettle by the window.
She phoned the clinic on Monday and booked an appointment for later that week.
Participants who slept under six hours finished the puzzle more slowly than the others.
The committee moved the meeting to evening so the new members were present.
A dog that eats grapes needs a vet visit and a night of close observation.
Buyers happily pay extra for coffee grown ethically on the high slopes.
The landlord's lease lists repairs among the services he provides each month.
The app launched last spring with a clean interface and a few simple games.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, census arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + concept-census evidence (which concepts and domains selected the pole)); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top examples are heterogeneous function tokens (commas, 'if', 'for', 'sure', 'less') sitting at a clause boundary after check/ask/likelihood predicates; the output promotes ' there'/' have', fitting a clause-subject slot. Census food-domain signal and the broad density suggest this is a weak, diffuse pole, so low confidence.
